$comment: Answers for a headless scaffold run:
This is what makes the template usable without a terminal you can type
into: a phone, a web session, CI. Copy this file, edit it, run it.
Each remote step takes one of three answers, and the third is the point:
true    do it now (needs the CLI, logged in)
false   I do not want this
"later" I want it, but this environment cannot do it: the run prints the
exact command in its closing to-do list instead.
Absent means false, so a forgotten key never triggers something remote.
No secrets belong in this file. Tokens go in .env, which is gitignored.
name: my-site
$comment_modules: Optional modules by id: "three" (WebGL recipe), "react-islands" (React Aria for widgets native HTML cannot do), "preview" (draft preview build). Omit or leave empty for none. Add one later with: node scripts/scaffold.ts --modules-only
$comment_github: pushScaffold: commit and push what the scaffold changed (Worker name, domain route, modules) before Cloudflare builds from GitHub. push: push to an origin that already exists (the 'Use this template' flow sets one). create: create a new PRIVATE repo with the gh CLI and push.
$comment_sanity: mode: "create" makes a new project, "existing" uses projectId below (needs NO CLI), "later" defers with the command printed, false skips.
cors: allows http://localhost:3333 (a local Studio) with credentials. The static site itself needs no CORS.
token: true mints a viewer read token into .env (private datasets and preview builds only).
removeGithubWebhook: true deletes an older webhook that still calls GitHub (it would deploy twice).
$comment_cloudflare: customDomain: true adds the production URL's host as a custom-domain route in wrangler.jsonc (DNS on Cloudflare, same account). Ignored for *.workers.dev.
deploy: true builds and runs `wrangler deploy` (needs wrangler logged in). "later" prints the commands.
autoDeploy: "1" Workers Builds + deploy hook + Sanity webhook (default), "2" GitHub Actions, "3" later.
Workers Builds reads its API token from CLOUDFLARE_BUILDS_TOKEN in the environment, never from this file. See docs/publishing.md.
firstBuild: true starts a Workers build at the end of the step.
